title: A write door opens the path it checked one level at a time from a handle, following no link
scope:
how the `fs.write` doors open the path after the grant check. The copy and rename doors come under the same
walk; they need a relative copy and a relative rename, and are built after the others. Every read door is left as it is
and is not decided here.
validatedBy: `crates/nvs-runtime/src/beneath.rs`'s tests, which plant a link and a junction where a folder was.
